messages.lifecycle.wake_brief.1: This is a checkpoint you registered yourself (task-deadline), and it is due now. Take over task {{task}}: read goal.md and status.md first, then do what you left for yourself: "{{note}}"{{about}}. That note is your own, not an instruction from {owner}; this wake-up grants nothing new, the approved scope is unchanged, and production changes still need {owner}'s approval on a card. Then leave the task in a clear closure state (rule 11): register another --wake if it needs another look, post a card for what {owner} must do or decide, and do not stop at "suggested next steps".

messages.lifecycle.continue_prompt.1: {owner} chose "Let the agent keep going" on the "task stalled with nobody driving it" card. Take over task {{task}}: read goal.md and status.md first, then drive it to a clear closure state — when done, set Linear to Done and write a closure line in status.md; to wait on a specific person, @-mention that person, add a watch and a ~1 working day deadline (Linear In Review, the assignee stays {owner}); to wait on {owner}, post a card; if it will not be done, set Linear to Canceled with the reason. Do not stop at "suggested next steps".
messages.lifecycle.close_prompt.1: {owner} chose "Close it" on the "task stalled with nobody driving it" card. Wrap up task {{task}}: set Linear to Done or Canceled as fits (Canceled with a one-line reason), and write a closure line in status.md (for example `closure: done` or `closure: closed (reason…)`). Do not change anything outside this task directory.

Drive it to a clear closure state (rule 11); do not stop at "suggested next steps".
